course.title: Machine Learning — Complete Deep AI Course
course.description: A Machine Learning-specific, beginner-to-advanced course with concept-first notes, practical implementations, dedicated tasks, evaluation, responsible AI considerations and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn the subject properly; no fixed cross-AI template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Work with realistic datasets and AI workflows.
Understand deployment, cost, privacy and safety considerations.
